answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through bonded identity escrow. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit to obtain a trading identity; reputation and income accrue only to identities that have held the zenith of verified uptime over time, and the bond is slashed on proven misbehavior. A thousand sockpuppets then cost a thousand bonds, while the nectar of honest earnings flows to one long-lived identity whose single deposit amortizes over years. The public ledger is crystal: peers see every bond, so the attacker pays a linear, visible cost and honest participation stays nearly free.
